chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Jawhari, from Hariz ibn Abdullah, similar to it.

key_terms.أَصْحَابُنَا: Our companions (referring to the Shia scholars/companions of the Imams)
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: Similar to it (indicating the content is the same as a previous hadith)

ai.seo_question: Who are the narrators in this chain from Al-Kafi chapter 51?
ai.summary: This segment from Al-Kafi’s Chapter 51 presents a secondary chain of transmission (isnad) linking back to the primary narration, highlighting the rigorous verification process in Shia hadith scholarship. It underscores the reliability of the report by showing its consistency across different narrators, specifically tracing the lineage through Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhari and Hariz ibn Abd Allah. This repetition serves to reinforce the authenticity and continuity of the prophetic tradition within the Imami scholarly framework.
